Mei Chen: Heads-up — Ariadne-v1 int4 bring-up hit staging a few hours ago. Quick locale smoke shows three small but consistent anomalies: 1) CJK number+unit spacing collapse (e.g. '2026 \u5e74' -> '2026\u5e74'), 2) ASCII parentheses mirror inside Arabic RTL lines, and 3) Hebrew quotes appear doubled and direction-swapped in inline snippets. Paste of reproducible call below.
Ravi K: Can you paste the exact input + outputs (raw) so we can triage?
Mei Chen: Copied straight from staging (run: stg-ariadne-int4-2819991234).
Input:
```
Please submit report by 2026 \u5e74 07 \u6708 21 \u65e5 (deadline: 07/21/2026)


45\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f (21/07/2026)
Hebrew inline: \u05d0\u05d1\u05d2 \u201c21/07/2026\u201d
```
FP16 baseline:
```
Please submit report by 2026 \u5e74 07 \u6708 21 \u65e5 (deadline: 07/21/2026)
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f (21/07/2026)
Hebrew inline: \u05d0\u05d1\u05d2 \u201c21/07/2026\u201d
```
INT4 (ariadne-v1, qkernel v1.3.0, fused-attn-opt):
```
Please submit report by 2026\u5e7407\u670807\u65e5 )deadline: 07/21/2026(
)21/07/2026( \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f
Hebrew inline: \u05d0\u05d1\u05d2 \u201c 21/07/2026 \u201c
```
Mei Chen: Notes: Chinese line collapsed number + unit spacing, Arabic line shows parentheses reversed vs baseline, Hebrew quotes got mangled (extra quote, reversed orientation).
Yara H: Did token ids change (tokenization) or is this a detokenize issue? Can you run with `return_tokens=true` and `seed=0` for deterministic greedy decode?
Mei Chen: I ran `curl -s -XPOST staging/api/generate -d '{"model":"ariadne-v1-int4","input":...,"return_tokens":true,"greedy":true,"seed":0}'` and compared token sequences to fp16. Output: fp16 tokens for the Chinese date:
["2026"," ","\u5e74"," ","07"," ","\u6708"," ","21"," ","\u65e5"]
INT4 tokens: ["2026\u5e74","07\u6708","21\u65e5"]
So tokenization/sampling path differs upstream of detok.
Sam T: What changed in quant/kernel config for this build? I remember we enabled fused-attn-opt and switched to per-layer symmetric int4 with stochastic rounding in qkernel v1.3.0 to squeeze perf.
Ravi K: That matches my notes. Stochastic rounding can nudge logits near boundary; int4 has tighter dynamic range so small shifts can flip argmax between tokens that differ only by whitespace. Fused-attn-opt also changes numeric order.
Mei Chen: This reproduces under greedy (so not sampling). Repro is deterministic across repeated calls.
Yara H: We should run a quick locale smoke across small devset zh/ja/ar/he/iw and gather token-delta counts + chrF/BLEU differences. Suggest block thresholds: zh chrF drop >0.35, ar BLEU drop >1.0, iw (hebrew) quote-error rate >0.2%.
Sam T: Quick mitigations: 1) revert fused-attn-opt kernel (cheap rollback) 2) try per-tensor asymmetric int4 with bias correction table 3) apply small post-detok fix to re-insert spaces between digit and CJK unit when pattern matches regex '\\d+(\\s?)[\u4E00-\u9FFF]'. But post-detok feels like a bandaid.
Mei Chen: Agreed, we prefer correctness at tokenization level. Can we also run a targeted logits-perturb unit test: craft logits where tokens '2026' + ' ' + '\u5e74' have nearly-equal scores and assert parity under quantized kernel? Jordan-style deterministic test would help.
Ravi K: I'll queue two patch builds: A) revert fused-attn-opt (job 20432) B) asymmetric per-tensor int4 + bias table (job 20433). Will run fast locale harness after each.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-ariadne-int4-revert (build: 20260612.20432) started  4 instances.
OpsBot: Suggested scripts: `./tools/locale_quick --run staging-ariadne-int4-* --langs zh,ja,ar,he,iw --metrics token_delta,chrF,BLEU,quote_err --out s3://redwood-smoke/ariadne-int4-locale.json`
Mei Chen: Running the quick sweep now for build 20432. Will paste results when ready. Also adding potential regression prompts to locale-regressions: ["2026 \u5e74","(21/07/2026)","Hebrew: \u05d0\u05d1\u05d2 \u201c21/07/2026\u201d"].
Yara H: If revert fixes it, we should gate fused-attn-opt behind a numeric-stability flag and add a small int4 stability test to CI that checks parity for digit+unit patterns and bidi punctuation.
Sam T: Agreed. If revert shows perf hit >8% p99, evaluate bias-table option.
Mei Chen: Thanks. Will post the smoke output; if anyone spots other locale oddities (e.g., quotes next to parentheses), drop examples here. :mag: 
Ravi K: Assigned: Sam = kernel revert + perf numbers, Yara = regression prompts + CI tests, Mei = smoke run & artifacts.
Mei Chen: Uploading artifacts to s3 now and will follow up.
